tools.name: getSystemHealth
tools.description: Use this to verify Meitheal is running before making other API calls. Returns version, uptime, database status, and Home Assistant connectivity. Call this first in any automation workflow.

tools.name: listTasks
tools.description: Retrieve Household tasks filtered by status, area, project, labels, priority, assignee, or due date. Use sort and limit parameters for pagination. This is the primary read endpoint for task management automations.

deferred.description: Use 1 for deferred work and 0 for other work. Omission returns both.

due_date.description: Match the stored calendar day, either a date-only value or the date written in a stored ISO timestamp. Invalid dates return 400.

sort.description: Equal values use task ID ascending; null values sort last.

tools.name: getTodayTaskCounts
tools.description: Returns counts over the full task database using the Today page rules. No task rows are returned.

tools.name: createTask
tools.description: Create a task with optional calendar sync, assignment, and framework payload. Authenticated callers can retry an identical request with the Idempotency-Key header. Use this when a user or agent wants to capture a new action item.

tools.name: completeTaskByNfcTag
tools.description: Complete the uniquely assigned incomplete task for an NFC tag

tools.name: manageTaskHandoff
tools.description: Requires tasks:propose. Claim returns a five-minute lease. Release and propose require that lease and the issuing token. Propose sends title or description changes to the administrator review queue without changing the task.

updates.description: Required for propose. Include at least one field.

tools.name: getTask
tools.description: Retrieve full task details including subtasks, checklists, comments count, and framework payload. Use this before updating a task to get its current state.

tools.name: updateTask
tools.description: Send only the fields you want to change. PATCH accepts the same fields as PUT. Set project_id to an existing project ID to move the task, or null to clear the assignment. Changing the project preserves task area and status. When a task transitions to 'complete', the update also saves the next occurrence if its recurrence rule yields one. Events are dispatched after the write. With expected_status 'backlog', send the exact updated_at from the current task and a target status of 'pending' or 'active'. To guard a checklist write, include checklists and expected_checklists. Set expected_checklists to the exact checklist string or null returned by GET.

description.description: Task text. The server keeps the first 10,000 characters.

status.description: Canonical task status, a supported alias, or a custom status. Backlog decisions require exactly pending or active.

priority.description: The server rounds and clamps this to 1 through 5.

is_promoted.description: Show the task above regular cards in its Kanban lane.

labels.description: Label names, as an array or as a JSON-encoded array.

expected_checklists.description: Exact previous checklist value returned by GET

updated_at.description: Observed task version as epoch milliseconds. Send the exact observed value with expected_status backlog.

expected_status.description: Requires exact updated_at and status pending or active. The task must still be in Backlog.

tools.name: deleteTask
tools.description: Permanently removes a task and its domain events. Consider setting status to 'archived' instead if you want recoverability.

tools.name: clearCompletedTasks
tools.description: Moves all tasks with status 'complete' to 'archived'. Use this in daily/weekly cleanup automations.

tools.name: deleteCompletedTasks
tools.description: ⚠️ Destructive. Permanently removes all tasks with status 'complete'. Cannot be undone. Prefer clearCompletedTasks for safe cleanup.

tools.name: reorderTasks
tools.description: Reorder the supplied tasks across their shared rank slots, or move one card relative to another card in the same Kanban lane and promotion group.

tools.name: getTaskComments
tools.description: Historical comments remain readable with task access. If Home Assistant cannot verify current membership, mention selectors are hidden and can_manage is false.

tools.name: addTaskComment
tools.description: Add a status update or handoff note. Home Assistant comment mentions require a current member, a rendered-account context, and a durable attempt header. Retry with the same text and attempt header for 48 hours under the original account. The JSON body is limited to 32 KiB.

tools.name: getTaskComment
tools.description: If Home Assistant cannot verify current membership, mention selectors are hidden.

tools.name: updateTaskComment
tools.description: The same currently active Home Assistant user or automation credential that created the comment may edit it. A display name does not grant ownership. Home Assistant edits containing mentions require the rendered-account context.

tools.name: deleteTaskComment
tools.description: Permanently remove a comment created by the same currently active Home Assistant user or automation credential.

tools.name: getTaskReactions
tools.description: Returns up to 50 reactions, newest first. Home Assistant ingress requires current membership. Automation tokens need tasks:read.

tools.name: addTaskReaction
tools.description: The same reaction by the same caller on the same target returns the existing reaction. The JSON body is limited to 1 KiB. Home Assistant ingress requires a fresh membership check before writing. Automation tokens need tasks:write.

content.description: One line of emoji or plain text. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed and the text is normalized to NFC.

tools.name: deleteTaskReaction
tools.description: Only the creator can remove a reaction. Home Assistant ingress requires a fresh membership check. Automation tokens need tasks:write.

tools.name: getTaskCommentReactions
tools.description: Returns up to 50 reactions, newest first. Home Assistant ingress requires current membership. Automation tokens need tasks:read.

tools.name: addTaskCommentReaction
tools.description: The same reaction by the same caller on the same target returns the existing reaction. The JSON body is limited to 1 KiB. Home Assistant ingress requires a fresh membership check before writing. Automation tokens need tasks:write.

content.description: One line of emoji or plain text. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed and the text is normalized to NFC.

tools.name: deleteTaskCommentReaction
tools.description: Only the creator can remove a reaction. Home Assistant ingress requires a fresh membership check. Automation tokens need tasks:write.

tools.name: getTaskReactionCounts
tools.description: Returns positive counts keyed by task ID. Comment reactions are excluded. Home Assistant ingress requires current membership. Automation tokens need tasks:read.

tools.name: getTaskActivity
tools.description: Returns the audit trail for a specific task — useful for understanding what changed and when.

tools.name: duplicateTask
tools.description: Creates a copy of the task with a new ID. Useful for creating recurring instances or templates.

tools.name: searchTasks
tools.description: The primary search endpoint for all Meitheal content. Supports scoped search (tasks, views, settings, actions), field selection, and sorting. Use scope=tasks for task-specific searches, or scope=all for universal discovery.

q.description: Search text. Omit for recent tasks.

limit.description: Positive decimal integer. The effective per-section limit is capped at 12.

tools.name: listAreas
tools.description: Areas are the top-level organizational containers (WHERE things happen). Every goal and project belongs to an area.

tools.name: listGoals
tools.description: Goals define WHAT you want to achieve. They belong to areas and can have metric tracking (percentage, count, boolean).

progress.description: Percentage derived from the stored metric. An update maps this percentage to the goal's metric target, or initializes a percentage target of 100.

tools.name: updateGoal
tools.description: Update a goal, including progress metrics

progress.description: Percentage derived from the stored metric. An update maps this percentage to the goal's metric target, or initializes a percentage target of 100.

tools.name: listProjects
tools.description: Projects are containers for tasks within an area. They can be linked to goals for progress tracking.

task_counts.description: Include full-project active, total and completed task counts.

tools.name: listPillars
tools.description: Pillars are the WHY layer — permanent motivational anchors representing who the user wants to be. Soft limit of 5-6 pillars.

tools.name: addPillarPrinciple
tools.description: Add a principle to a pillar

tools.name: listPillarAssociations
tools.description: List goals/habits associated with a pillar

tools.name: addPillarAssociation
tools.description: Associate a goal or habit with a pillar

tools.name: listHabits
tools.description: Returns habit templates with current streak data, schedule, and completion history.

tools.name: updateHabit
tools.description: Send { complete: true } to record today's completion. Send other fields to update the template.

tools.name: getSettings
tools.description: Without key, returns a flat settings map. An administrator's map includes the read-only ai-handoff-editable flag. With key, returns a single { key, value } object; secret settings also include configured. System settings require administrator access and credential values are masked. Use key=ai-provider&handoff=1 for the saved provider and permitted destination in one snapshot. This view requires current Home Assistant household access or a local standalone operator. Members can read a custom URL after a current administrator explicitly shares that exact URL. Agent credentials cannot use the handoff view.

key.description: Read one setting instead of the settings map

handoff.description: Request the current AI handoff snapshot with key=ai-provider

tools.name: updateSettings
tools.description: Send a key and value. System settings and activating Custom mode require administrator access. With custom_theme_css, send name to save the CSS, filename and mode together. Send both strings empty to remove the theme. For a Settings editor save of ai-provider, include the previously saved provider, URL and sharing state. Custom and Ollama additionally require the new destination and sharing choice, which commit together with the provider. A legacy ai-custom-url write revokes approval if it changes the destination. Read ai-custom-url-approved as an administrator to inspect the approval; set it through the grouped save.

icon.description: Null or omission uses the default icon.

createdFrom.description: Inclusive lower creation date, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty omits the bound.

createdThrough.description: Inclusive upper creation date, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty omits the bound.

tools.name: listUsers
tools.description: Returns users from Home Assistant integration combined with any custom-defined users.

tools.name: getGamificationStats
tools.description: Returns XP, level, streaks, and unlocked achievements. Useful for motivation dashboards and daily briefings.

tools.name: startPomodoro
tools.description: Start or control a pomodoro session

tools.name: getWeeklyReview
tools.description: Returns completed tasks, velocity trends, focus areas, and suggestions for the current or specified week. Perfect for weekly automation digests.

tools.name: listRules
tools.description: Rules engine for automatic task mutations (e.g., auto-assign, auto-label, auto-prioritize).

tools.name: resolveRules
tools.description: Dry-run: shows what rules would fire for a given task payload without applying changes.

tools.name: getLicenseStatus
tools.description: Returns plan type, expiry, and validation state. Grace mode: app is fully functional without a license.

tools.name: sendHAAssist
tools.description: Send a message to HA Assist

tools.name: testWebhook
tools.description: Sends a test event to configured webhook endpoints. Use this to verify webhook connectivity.

tools.name: testEvent
tools.description: Fire a test HA event bus event

tools.name: getTodoItems
tools.description: Get items from a HA todo list

tools.name: syncTodo
tools.description: Sync tasks with HA todo lists

tools.name: unfurlUrl
tools.description: Send the final public HTTP or HTTPS URL without embedded credentials. The App reads up to 256 KiB of decoded HTML within the request deadline.

tools.name: getA2AAgentCard
tools.description: Get the A2A agent card for read-only task search

tools.name: sendA2AMessage
tools.description: Requires a token with a2a:execute and search:read and the A2A-Version: 1.0 header. SendMessage returns up to eight active task titles and links. Results are read-only.

tools.name: createAgentToken
tools.description:
Issue a zero-trust agent token with fine-grained scopes. The plaintext token is returned ONCE in the response — store it securely. Requires admin access (HA admin or settings:write scope).

**For n8n/Node-RED**: Create a token with only the scopes your workflow needs, then set it as Bearer token in your HTTP Request node.

items.description: Fine-grained permission scope for agent tokens. Use least-privilege: grant only what the agent needs.

tools.name: listAgentTokens
tools.description: Returns public metadata for all active tokens. Token hashes and plaintexts are never exposed. Requires admin access.

tools.name: updateAgentToken
tools.description: Modify the display name or permission scopes of an existing token. The token value itself cannot be changed — revoke and recreate if compromised.

items.description: Fine-grained permission scope for agent tokens. Use least-privilege: grant only what the agent needs.

tools.name: deleteAgentToken
tools.description: By default, soft-revokes the token (keeps record for audit trail). Set `hard: true` to permanently delete. Revoked tokens immediately stop working.
